description: UNDERSTANDING — Export a designed capability stack as an adoptable APIs.json document (with an Arazzo hint) the team can commit. Priced B3 (bulk export) — $0.002 per row, $0.50 minimum per call under pay-as-you-go; included in Understanding and Influence. See apis://prices.

capabilities.description: The capabilities the stack needs, e.g. ["payments","email","identity"].

context.description: Optional: why you are asking. One sentence — the task you are trying to complete, or what you expect to get back. Never included in the answer and never used to rank; it is read only when a result turns out to be wrong, which is when knowing the intent is what makes the report actionable.

name: export_stack
